name: AMOS22: Abdominal Multi-Organ Benchmark for Medical Image Segmentation
description: The AMOS dataset (A Large-Scale Abdominal Multi-Organ Benchmark for Versatile Medical Image Segmentation) was created for the AMOS22 Grand Challenge and published in NeurIPS 2022. It provides a comprehensive multi-modality, multi-scanner, multi-disease benchmark for abdominal organ segmentation. The labeled dataset consists of 600 high-resolution volumetric clinical scans (500 contrast-enhanced abdominal CT scans and 100 abdominal MRI scans) collected from multi-center clinical routines. Expert radiologists annotated 15 anatomical structures: spleen, right kidney, left kidney, gallbladder, esophagus, liver, stomach, aorta, inferior vena cava, pancreas, right adrenal gland, left adrenal gland, duodenum, bladder, and prostate/uterus. The challenge partitions the 600 cases into 360 training, 120 validation, and 120 test volumes.
